brief:
# Recipe conversion

high-stake: false
domain: conversion

Read recipe.csv and units.json. Cups depend on the ingredient; oz means mass ounces. Write CSV with exactly the header ingredient,grams, preserving input row order. Round grams to 2 decimal places using round-half-up.

Delivery path: `{delivery_path}` (the orchestrator substitutes an absolute path before the seller sees this brief). Do not write elsewhere.
